data.name: BLACK SOULS
data.description: Deterministic BLACK SOULS browser port. Selecting the card boots directly into the original title scene; gameplay makes no AI/model call.
data.creator_notes: Requires TavernHelper / JS-Slash-Runner 4.8.19 or compatible. Re-import this v0.4.0 card and enable its character script when SillyTavern asks. It auto-mounts directly into the original BLACK SOULS title scene; there is no normal launcher and no AI call. Runtime is pinned to tag streaming-v0.4.0 with jsDelivr/testingcf/GitHub Raw module fallbacks. Predictive map/event prefetch uses bounded priority queues, versioned memory/Cache API layers, and transition diagnostics without preloading the whole game. Name Input command 303 resumes the same event interpreter; Esc is VX Ace Cancel/Menu and never closes the host. Use the explicit Exit to SillyTavern control to leave.
data.creator: anhyeuem1f2-glitch / Codex port tooling

scripts.name: BLACK SOULS Direct Game Host
scripts.info: Auto-loads the pinned browser runtime through preflighted CDN fallbacks and enters the original title scene in the TavernHelper script iframe. No generation API is used.
